reviews.review: Please make this game first person if that is even possible, a developer nightmare but still just try..... i will r8 this game 8/8 because i apreci8 and i don't h8... :D

Before i say anything, let me be clear, this is a very good game and i do fully reccomend it.

Now that that's out of the way, i do have problems with it. For one, the corpus are impossible to stealth through (which honestly just makes it all the more satisfying to kill them with any for of stealth, but i digress). They are a swarm of 20 or so different types of enemies ranging from typicaly gunners to chargers to assault walkers and just about anything else you can think of. This is no longer as big of a problem because the difficulty shift between corpus and grineer factions has been balanced with added grineer (unless the grineer napalm and bmbardier types dont show up in the starter worlds).

second grievence, crafting can be grindy as all hell. For as balanced as it can be (it takes lots of credits or resources that are hard to get to obtain high-rank things without paying), there is the problem that you can't upgrade your starter bow, should you choose it, until you get to saturn, which is quite a ways away from start, while you can just outright buy an upgraded rifle with enough credits.

final grievence, parkour can be at times clunky and glitchy. Example, in one grineer-style room are pillars that you are supposed to climb in order to reach the catwalk the next level. climbing these can be quite a challenge as they are not registored as flat sufaces to run on, making it harder to get up to previously mentioned catwalk.


Other than these, the game excels quite far. The combat is responsive and feels right, all the weapons feel like they're suppose to function as they do (at least the ones i've managed to use) and, in terms of looks, the game is beutiful, the orokin void especially. multiple times have i just stopped my rampage through them to admire the detail and thought put into them.

As a game, warframe functions almost perfectly into it's genre of sci-fi, but not so much into the ninja-stealth game it claims to be. however it can be a stealth game in many occasions should you get lucky to find someone who doesn't try to speed run levels or just go headlong into everything.
